scope: Chosen transparent TYPE aliases and bounded STRING alias parameters; offline execution only

implementation_choices.resolution: Resolve aliases and chains eagerly to supported types already defined in TYPE declaration order; case-insensitive names; no new scalar nominal identity
implementation_choices.aggregate_identity: Aliases preserve original ARRAY and STRUCTURE identities, nested component identities, shapes, capacities and joint widths; fresh aggregate definitions remain distinct
implementation_choices.interfaces: Use aliases in globals, locals, fields, elements, parameters and supported results; named result aliases must precede the routine; BYTE/SHORT remain element/field-only
implementation_choices.bounded_string_parameters: Require exact capacity for bare references; value copies check initialized ASCII input of at most 254 characters, then truncate to the bounded alias capacity; later writes retain that capacity; no copy-back
implementation_choices.storage: Keep existing initialization, whole-copy, value/result leaf-completeness, numeric, sentinel, ownership, positional context and FOR counter checks
implementation_choices.report: type_aliases records name, immediate target, resolved spec and physical location; user_types and named_array_types expose resolved identities; type_alias_policy and temporary_capacity describe the current behavior

retained_boundaries: No forward, self or cyclic aliases, duplicate names or alias declaration collisions
No external FROM linkage, local TYPE sections, wildcard TYPE dimensions, unsupported type aliases or inline anonymous nested ARRAY definitions
No standalone BYTE/SHORT variables, parameters or results
No new native compiler, type-registration, storage ABI or controller runtime claims; conservative tests retained for the future strict milestone
